_comment: Copy as config.json (Or specify another path using the environment variable ARTEX_CONFIG). This file only contains database and skill_dir items; other configurations like LLM use environment variables or application settings, not this file.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL Connect. Priority: environment variable ARTEX_PG_DSN > This file database. Two ways to write, choose one:(A) Fill in the following fields;(B) Only fill in 'database'..dsn A complete connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Writing (B): Delete the above database and use a complete DSN. When the DSN is non-empty, it ignores field-specific settings.
_comment_skill_dir: skill Root directory (one skill per subdirectory, containing SKILL).md). Priority: environment variable ARTEX_SKILL_DIR > This field > Default (in the same directory as the executable files). Leaving this field blank or deleting it will use the default. Relative paths are resolved relative to the current working directory.
